label: rem:h2o-molecular-braid-remark
title: Bonding generators and symmetry of the water braid
html:
Of the H_\lambda(q) generators, the N - k = 25 intra-block generators are internal to the three atoms. The k - 1 = 2 cross-block (bonding) generators are the two O–H \sigma-bonds. The assembly projector selects the Wedderburn block \mu that pairs each hydrogen's electron with oxygen. The formalisation fixed: total N = 28, two bonding generators, and the hydrogen-exchange symmetry of the partition.

Two interpretations follow. First, the molecular point symmetry acts as the stabiliser of e_{\lambda,\mu}. Second, the lone pairs of oxygen force a bent geometry.
